rationale: The workflow is a scheduled/manual external orchestration job that scans remote branches of linuxserver/docker-jackett and triggers Jenkins builds; it installs no dependencies, runs no matrix, and has no build/test steps. All historical runs complete in about 41-45 seconds and succeed. Assessed patterns: P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE is contraindicated because results depend on external repository/Jenkins state, not only repository changes; P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW lacks a repository skip policy and has a <0.1% paid-vm-time upper bound; P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is unnecessary given short, consistent successful runs with no runaway evidence; P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE has no failure streak (all runs success). Cache, fail-fast, matrix, and path-filter patterns do not apply. No supported optimization fits without risking the intended trigger coverage.
